headline: Phillips 66 (PSX) Gains On Refining Strength, Is The Stock Fully Priced?
summary: Phillips 66 (PSX) is back in focus as Iran related disruptions in oil markets and record crack spreads support U.S. refiners, while the company’s earnings, buybacks, and dividend policy shape current investor sentiment. See our latest analysis for Phillips 66. Against this backdrop of Iran related supply risks and strong refining economics, Phillips 66’s share price has climbed to US$205.85, with a 30 day share price return of 19.92% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 65.80%.
